remarks: Location, location, location!! Within walking distance to Greenwich Avenue and the train station, this gorgeous townhouse in Belle Manor is the one you have been waiting for. You could be the lucky tenant to be the first to live here after an extensive refurbishment. This top floor condo has everything you could need - bright spacious rooms, a fireplace, a garage with storage area and visitor parking, access to a little yard. The brand new kitchen sparkles with brand new cabinets, countertops and appliances. Upstairs there is a large primary bedroom with generous closet space and a beautiful full bath. The second bedroom also has its own full bath. In unit laundry. Move right in!
